concept: Athena: serverless SQL directly on data in S3
tests: Choosing a service for SQL queries on data in S3 without loading into a DB, with no infrastructure and pay-per-query.
expected: Amazon Athena — serverless, standard SQL (Presto/Trino) over S3, billed per data scanned. Triggers: "query data directly in S3", "standard SQL", "without loading", "pay per query".
why_not: Redshift — needs a cluster (except Spectrum/Serverless); RDS — data must be loaded; EMR — a big-data cluster to manage.
